about: A recipe, not game data: neutral ids, our own words, and references into the game (the stage actor name, its process, the archive it loads, the fixed parameter word). The objects themselves load from the player's own game files.

objects.label: Big nest
objects.description: a large bird's nest Link can stand in; it rocks a little when he moves

transform.why: its collision keeps the unscaled shape

memory.measured: own heap 12812 bytes and about 1 KiB more

objects.label: Small red flag
objects.description: a small red flag on a pole that flutters in the wind

transform.why: the cloth keeps its own size

memory.measured: own heap 90352-90504 bytes (the cloth) and about 1 KiB more

objects.notes: no parameters are read; the cloth uses the game's shared cloth archive

objects.label: Tall banner flag
objects.description: a tall flag on a pole that flutters in the wind

transform.why: the cloth keeps its own size

memory.measured: own heap 90352-90504 bytes (the cloth) and about 1 KiB more

objects.notes: no parameters are read; the cloth uses the game's shared cloth archive

objects.label: Sea lookout tower
objects.description: a tall wooden lookout platform that stands in the sea, with or without a ladder Link can climb

transform.why: its collision keeps the unscaled shape

memory.measured: own heap 53084 bytes with the ladder and about 1 KiB more; the archive is in a permanent pack

objects.notes: bit 0 adds the ladder (its own collision, climbable as the game's own); nothing else is read; no switches, save bits or events, and no other code looks for it
